tasks.title: Add publicationProhibition schema definition
tasks.description: Define publicationProhibition in lib/Settings/docudesk_register.json: primaryName, entityType, matchRules, reason, legalAuthority, caseReference, severity, jurisdiction, addedBy, validFrom, validUntil, active, notes.

tasks.title: Extend publicationConsent with scope discriminator
tasks.description: Add scope (enum: document, entity; default document) to publicationConsent. Existing records load as scope=document automatically.

tasks.title: Extend publicationConsent with entity-scope fields
tasks.description: Add matchRules, validFrom, validUntil, active, consentMethod, consentDocument, consentScope to publicationConsent. None added to top-level required - service-level enforcement gates them by scope.

tasks.title: Add policyMatch polymorphic reference field
tasks.description: Add policyMatch to publicationConsent: type object, oneOf $ref to publicationProhibition and to publicationConsent (self-ref for standing consents), objectConfiguration.handling: related-object. Optional.

tasks.title: Confirm consentStatus enum is unchanged
tasks.description: No new values added. Existing values (pending, consent_given, objection_received, no_response, anonymized) cover all outcomes; the policy-pre-empted distinction lives in policyMatch + notificationStatus.

tasks.title: Verify schema imports cleanly
tasks.description: Run composer test:unit (or equivalent) - no JSON syntax errors, no schema validation rejections.

tasks.title: Seed 4 publicationProhibition records
tasks.description: Court order, minor protection, undercover officer, categorical exemption. @self envelope with stable slugs.

tasks.title: Seed 4 standing-consent records as scope=entity publicationConsent
tasks.description: Mayor blanket consent, KvK opt-in, council member, recorded verbal consent. publicationConsent records with scope=entity, consentStatus=consent_given, consentMethod populated, validFrom/validUntil set, active=true. @self envelope.

tasks.title: Verify seed import is idempotent
tasks.description: Re-running the import skips existing objects matched by slug. Smoke test on clean install + double import.

tasks.title: Create PolicyMatchService with in-memory rule cache
tasks.description: Load at init: all active publicationProhibition records + all active scope=entity publicationConsent records with open time bounds. O(1) per-tuple lookup keyed by (matchType, entityType, value).

tasks.title: Implement match-order: prohibition first, then standing consent
tasks.description: At most one match returned. Multi-prohibition tie-break: lowest UUID lexicographically (deterministic).

tasks.title: Honor time bounds at match time
tasks.description: Future validFrom / past validUntil / active false MUST NOT match. Applies to both source schemas.

tasks.title: Implement match types exact, normalized, bsn, kvk
tasks.description: normalized strips case + accents (Transliterator). Reject unknown types defensively.

tasks.title: Subscribe to object-changed events with scope filtering
tasks.description: On publicationProhibition events: invalidate the prohibition portion of the cache. On publicationConsent events: filter by scope - scope=entity invalidates the standing-consent portion; scope=document does NOT.

tasks.title: Unit-test PolicyMatchService
tasks.description: Each match type, time bounds, active flag, multi-rule precedence, multi-prohibition tie-break, prohibition-vs-standing-consent conflict. Verify scope-filtering on publicationConsent events.

tasks.title: Extend ConsentService::createConsentRequest with policy lookup
tasks.description: Prohibition match → consentStatus=anonymized + notificationStatus=skipped + publicationDecision=anonymize + policyMatch → prohibition. Standing-consent match → consentStatus=consent_given + notificationStatus=skipped + publicationDecision=publish_with_consent + policyMatch → standing consent. No match → existing WOO unchanged with scope=document and policyMatch=null.

tasks.title: Block transitions on records with non-null policyMatch
tasks.description: Reject any consentStatus transition to a different terminal value when policyMatch is non-null. Allowed: re-pointing policyMatch when underlying rule is replaced; recording publication-decision override on standing-consent matches.

tasks.title: Implement scope-validation rules at write time
tasks.description: Reject scope=document writes missing documentId; reject scope=entity writes that include documentId; reject scope=entity writes missing matchRules or consentMethod; reject policyMatch on scope=entity records; reject publicationConsent referents in policyMatch whose own scope is not entity.

tasks.title: Unit-test the four detection-time outcomes
tasks.description: no match → WOO; prohibition → anonymized + policyMatch → prohibition; standing consent → consent_given + policyMatch → standing consent; both → prohibition wins (audit log captures both rule UUIDs).

tasks.title: Unit-test scope-validation rules
tasks.description: The four corners: scope × valid/invalid required-set. Cover all rejection paths from 4.3.

tasks.title: Force-resolve in-flight records on prohibition INSERT
tasks.description: On prohibition rule add (or update making it match more entities), update matching in-flight scope=document publicationConsent records to consentStatus=anonymized + notificationStatus=skipped + publicationDecision=anonymize + policyMatch populated. Cancel pending notifications.

tasks.title: Do NOT modify in-flight records on standing-consent INSERT
tasks.description: Standing-consent addition leaves existing scope=document publicationConsent records as-is. Future detections benefit.

tasks.title: Preserve past records on rule DELETE / expiry
tasks.description: Past scope=document publicationConsent records keep their final state for either source. Future detections fall through.

tasks.title: Unit-test retroactive force-resolve
tasks.description: Including the case where in-flight record had objection_received (prohibition overrides explicit objection — privacy default). Verify notificationSentAt and objectionReceivedAt are preserved while objectionDeadline is cleared.

tasks.section: UI — three admin surfaces and toggle behavior
tasks.title: Render anonymization toggle keyed off policyMatch referent type
tasks.description: policyMatch → publicationProhibition: ON locked. policyMatch → publicationConsent (scope=entity): OFF defaulted, enabled. policyMatch null: existing UX based on consentStatus.

tasks.section: UI — three admin surfaces and toggle behavior
tasks.title: Override-up flow for standing-consent matches
tasks.description: Flipping the toggle records the override; updates publicationDecision: anonymize while preserving consentStatus=consent_given and policyMatch.

tasks.section: UI — three admin surfaces and toggle behavior
tasks.title: Use @conduction/nextcloud-vue components
tasks.description: CnFormDialog / CnDataTable / CnIndexPage per ADR-012. No custom equivalents.

tasks.section: UI — three admin surfaces and toggle behavior
tasks.title: Build three separate admin pages
tasks.description: Consent Workflow (scope=document filter, with policy-pre-empted indicator on policyMatch non-null rows). Standing Publication Consents (scope=entity filter; create-form requires consentMethod, warns if validUntil blank, encourages BSN/KvK). Publication Prohibitions (CRUD for publicationProhibition; warns when only name-based rules added).

tasks.section: UI — three admin surfaces and toggle behavior
tasks.title: Browser tests for toggle states and admin pages
tasks.description: Locked toggle for prohibition matches; defaulted-off-overridable for standing-consent matches; existing flow unaffected. Each admin page lists only the records of its scope/schema. scope=entity create form requires consentMethod. Standing consents and prohibitions never appear on the wrong page.

tasks.title: Configure default RBAC for publicationProhibition
tasks.description: read open to authenticated; write restricted to docudesk-policy-admins (or equivalent privileged group). Document in schema authorization block.

tasks.title: Service-level RBAC check for scope=entity publicationConsent
tasks.description: Enforce in the consent service: writing scope=entity requires membership in standing-consent group (e.g. docudesk-standing-consent-admins). scope=document writes remain governed by the schema-level consent-officer role.

tasks.title: Smoke-test RBAC enforcement
tasks.description: Unprivileged user POSTing publicationProhibition gets 403. Consent-officer can POST scope=document but is rejected on scope=entity attempts.

tasks.title: Document policy layer in publication-consent-process.md
tasks.description: Describe the publicationProhibition schema, the scope=entity flavor of publicationConsent, conflict resolution, retroactive behavior, UI toggle semantics, three admin surfaces. Diagram the three-layer model and the four discriminator combinations of policyMatch × notificationStatus.
